name: Consolation Tote
text: When this card loses a trick, gain +60 gold.
archetypes: Gold Miner, Diamond Flood; splash Blind Bidder, Nil Champion
decision: When to spend this card as a loser: on a trick you can't win anyway, rather than pushing it for a win.
opponent: Visible when it pays; opponents who trump your diamonds still take the trick, and choosing not to overtake it denies the gold.
aiNote: Play this card on a trick you are already losing; lead it only if it is the highest diamond still out.
rationale: Engraving places it on a face card, which loses about 60% of the time, and losing it gives up a likely winner, so +60 pays for the sacrifice, about 35 gold a round; it fills the thin "when this card loses" window. Nil rounds lose nearly every card, so it fires almost every time.
deviation: Removed the diamond affinity, which didn't change how the effect played.
